source: restart/crash scenario on a real model (stratum 8)

crashIntegrity.verdict: PASS - at SIGKILL the run was non-terminal, one worker running, two pending, none falsely completed

costPerSuccessNote: run ended failed/incomplete: one worker exhausted review retries. Cost is real; cost-per-success is UNDEFINED.
fixedThisRun: recomputeRunStatus: pending work no longer yields a terminal failed status
reconciliation: dead-owner workers reset to pending + attempt instead of terminal failed
objective review: judged against the ASSIGNED worker objective, not the rendered prompt
objective review: evidence scoped to paths this worker actually owns
remainingDefect: objective reviewer is non-deterministic: identical correct content sometimes returns satisfied:true, sometimes a gaps-style rejection. Isolated sampling passed 6/6, so it appears load/concurrency-sensitive. NOT fixed.
